import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    sep = 0
    row_groups = []
    start = 0
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(v == sep for v in row):
            if start < i: row_groups.append((start, i))
            start = i + 1
    if start < len(grid): row_groups.append((start, len(grid)))
    cols = len(grid[0])
    cut_cols = [c for c in range(cols) if all(row[c] == sep for row in grid)]
    col_groups = []
    start = 0
    for c in cut_cols + [cols]:
        if start < c: col_groups.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    base = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep)
    special = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (sep, base))
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_groups:
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in col_groups:
            n = sum(row[c0:c1].count(special) for row in grid[r0:r1])
            line.append(1 if n == 2 else base)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
